cases.title: Real briefs, real results
cases.lede: Pretty pictures are easy. What matters is how a home works once you live in it. Here's what our clients asked for, what we did, and how it turned out.
cases.compare_label: Drag to compare before and after
cases.c1_before_alt: Before: a dim, cluttered living room with grey walls, a bare bulb and boxes on the floor.
cases.c1_after_alt: After: the same living room made bright and open, with light wood, a sage sofa and built-in storage.
cases.c1_title: A young family's condo, finally with room to breathe
cases.c1_brief: A dark, cramped living and dining area with toys everywhere and nowhere to put them. The couple wanted a calm home that could survive a toddler.
cases.c1_did: We removed a non-structural partition to open up the space, added a built-in bench with hidden storage, and used light oak, sage and warm, layered lighting.
cases.c1_result: The living area feels twice as open, everything has a home, and cleaning up takes minutes instead of an hour.
cases.c2_title: A 90s kitchen turned sunny family hub
cases.c2_brief: An old, closed-off kitchen with almost no counter space, where the family couldn't cook together.
cases.c2_did: We re-planned it into an L-shape with a small island, used easy-clean surfaces and warm wood cabinets, and let in more daylight.
cases.c2_result: Double the prep space, and the kitchen is now where everyone ends up.
cases.c3_title: From dining table office to a proper study nook
cases.c3_brief: Working from the dining table every day meant packing up the laptop for every meal.
cases.c3_did: We turned an unused corner into a study nook with a built-in desk, wall shelves and a mirror to bounce the light.
cases.c3_result: A real workspace that fits in less than 30 sq ft, and dinner is back on the table.
cases.promise_3: One point of contact, from design to handover

services.title: Design help, from first sketch to final cushion
services.s1_text: Concept, layout, materials, lighting and furniture — one clear design for the whole home.
services.s2_text: We coordinate contractors and site work so your renovation stays on plan and on budget.
services.s3_text: Smart layouts and 3D visuals, so you can see the space before a single wall moves.
services.s4_text: Furniture, art, textiles and plants picked to finish the room and make it yours.

process.title: Four simple steps
process.s1_text: Tell us about your space, your plans and your budget. A quick chat on WhatsApp is perfect.
process.s2_text: We measure up, listen to how you live, and agree on the scope together.
process.s3_text: Layouts, mood boards and 3D visuals — refined with you until it feels just right.
process.s4_text: We see it through on site and style the finishing touches. You bring the keys.

story.title: It all started with a tiny rented flat.
story.lede: Imili didn't begin in a fancy office. It began in a small, dim rental with one window, a tight budget and a landlord who said, "No nails in the walls, please."
story.img_alt: Illustration of a mood board with fabric swatches, a paint chip, a wood sample and a leaf.
story.ch1_text: Our first project was our own home. With no drilling allowed, we got creative: renter-friendly shelves, a fresh coat of paint (with permission!), second-hand furniture brought back to life, and plants in every corner of light. The little flat became the place everyone wanted to hang out.
story.ch2_text: Friends came over for dinner and left asking the same question. One flat became three. Soon our weekends were full of measuring tapes, sketches and hunting for the perfect tile, and we loved every minute of it.
story.ch3_text: When the weekend side project outgrew the weekends, it needed a name. We chose Imili: short, soft and easy to say in English, Bahasa Melayu or Mandarin, just like the homes we want to make. Simple, warm, and made for everyone.
story.quote: Today we're still a small studio, and we like it that way. Every project gets our full attention, from the first WhatsApp message to the last cushion.
story.v1_text: Timeless bones with a playful touch.
story.v2_text: Easy to clean, easy to live in, easy to love.
story.v3_text: Honest scope, honest pricing, no surprises.

faq.title: Questions we often get
faq.q1: Do you take on small projects?
faq.a1: Yes! From a single bedroom or a study nook to a whole home, tell us what you have in mind.
faq.q2: How much does interior design cost?
faq.a2: It depends on the size of the space and the scope of work. Share a few details with us and we'll give you a clear quotation.
faq.q3: Can you help with renovation too?
faq.a3: We can coordinate the renovation and work with trusted contractors, so you have one team from design to handover.
faq.q4: What should I prepare before we talk?
faq.a4: Your floor plan (or a few photos), a rough budget, your ideal timeline and any inspiration pictures you love.
faq.a5: English, Bahasa Melayu and Mandarin. Chat with us in whichever you're most comfortable with.

contact.title: Got a space in mind?
